title: Morphine

attribution.author: Josie Kins
attribution.text: Forked from Subjective Effect Documentation work by Josie Kins, August 2016.

notes.overview: Effects vary widely by individual, dose, and context.

effects.name: Internal hallucinations
effects.description: One may experience a state of semi-consciousness and hypnagogia during heavy dosage nodding which results in dream-like states and up to level 3 imagery. This is often accompanied by ill-defined geometry.

effects.name: Euphoria
effects.description: The cognitive euphoria experienced on this substance is extremely intense when compared to other opioids such as codeine or tramadol. The sensation itself can be described as powerful and overwhelming feelings of emotional bliss, contentment, and happiness.

effects.name: Euphoria
effects.description: The physical euphoria experienced on this substance is extremely intense when compared to other opioids such as codeine or tramadol. The sensation itself can be described as feelings of intense physical comfort, warmth, love and blissful euphoria.
